# H & H Custom Cabinetry — Full Site Reference

H & H Custom Cabinetry creates cabinetry with beauty, function, and lasting value for homes across the Greater Toronto and Hamilton Area (GTHA). The company has more than 20 years of cabinetry experience and provides personalized design guidance and careful installation.

## Services

### Custom kitchens

Kitchen cabinetry is planned around the homeowner's lifestyle, storage needs, space, style, and budget. Available choices include layouts, door styles, colours, materials, finishes, hardware, and interior storage options.

### Bathroom vanities

Options include single and double vanities, floating vanities, furniture-style vanities, linen storage, and other custom bathroom cabinetry.

### Custom built-ins and storage

Made-to-measure cabinetry is available for entertainment areas, offices, living rooms, fireplaces, laundry rooms, mudrooms, bars, bedrooms, and other storage spaces.

## Process

1. Free consultation: discuss the project, space, style, budget, and goals.
2. Design and selection: plan the layout and compare doors, colours, finishes, materials, hardware, and storage.
3. Final design: refine and confirm the cabinetry details.
4. Installation: install the finished cabinetry with care.
